title: Inside Reverse Fold
description: A point folds inside itself, reversing the centre crease.

steps.title: Make a triangle
steps.instruction: Fold the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner.
tips: The fold edge becomes the spine of the reverse fold.

steps.title: Crease the point
steps.instruction: Fold the point over through both layers, then unfold.
tips: A sharp precrease guides the reverse fold.

steps.title: Open the paper
tips: Look for the two creases that meet the diagonal.
mistakes: Losing track of the point creases.

steps.title: Reverse the tip
steps.instruction: Reverse the diagonal at the tip and one point crease.
tips: Only the short creases near the point change.

steps.title: Push inside
steps.instruction: Refold the diagonal; push the point inside.
tips: Open the layers slightly and push the spine in.
mistakes: Folding the point outside instead of between the layers.
steps.check: The point sits between the two layers.
